{"metadata":{"description":"Behavior-management plugin for DeepSeek Harness: tool-call discipline prompt section, failure-triggered parallelism convergence (pool drops to 1, auto-restores), consecutive-failure user intervention. Complements dsh-token-optimizer; works standalone.","id":"gh:1355716819","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-behavior-enhancer","slug":"Zoria-Lind/dsh-behavior-enhancer","topics":["agent","agent-behavior","agent-behavior-development","agent-behavior-rule-builder","agent-behaviors","agent-middleware","agent-skill","agent-skills","agents","awesome","awesome-list","deepseek","deepseek-harness","deepseek-harness-plugin","deepseek-harness-plugins","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Behavior-management plugin for DeepSeek Harness: tool-call discipline prompt section, failure-trigge"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"red parallelism convergence (pool drops to 1, auto-restores), consecutive-failure user intervention."},{"id":"p1s3","text":" Complements dsh-token-optimizer; works standalone."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-behavior-enhancer"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> DeepSeek Harness 行为管理插件：改变模型**怎么调用工具**，让复杂任务更稳定，不干预内容本身。
> 与 dsh-token-optimizer 职责互补——
> **token-"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"optimizer 管内容**（压缩/裁剪/采样），**本插件管行为**（调用纪律/失败收敛/连续失败介入）。两者互不依赖，可独立安装。"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## 它做什么（30 秒版）"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"| 模块 | 机制 | 说明 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| behaviorPrompt | `ctx.inject(['systemPrompt'])` + `systemP"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"rompt.section()` | 注册静态行为约束段（先读后写、批量前先验证、失败即收敛、同类修改串行）。**软约束**，强制靠下面模块 |
| parallelConvergence | `to"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ols/result` + `settings.update('agent-loop', {maxParallelToolCalls})` | 任何工具失败（含命令级失败）→ 并行池上限压到 1；连续"},{"id":"p5s4","text":" 3 次成功 → 恢复用户原值；上下文压力 ≥60%（idle 测量）→ 降档，回落 <54% 滞回恢复。串行状态**跨进程持久化**，重启自动接管还原 |
| failureGuard | `too"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"ls/result` + `agent.followup()` | 同工具连续失败 ≥2 次 → 向模型注入提示，引导它向用户确认而不是继续重试 |
| postWriteCheck | `tools"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"/execute`（写前快照）+ `tools/post-execute`（写后检查） | write/edit 写入后做轻量语法解析（JSON 用 JSON.parse；YAML/代码做字符串与注释"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"感知的括号配对 + YAML tab 缩进检查）。失败自动从 `.bak` 快照回滚并改写工具结果报告模型；≥3 个问题弹窗三选一（仅本次校验 / 本次+后续自动升级 / 不校验）。快照存 `~/.d"},{"id":"p5s8","text":"sh-memory/files/`（独立于记忆池），每文件保留最近 5 份 |
| projectMemory | `tools/execute`（记录写前大小）+ `tools/post-execu"},{"id":"p5s9","text":"te`（写后校验） | 模型写入 `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` / `AGENTS.local.md` / `CLAUDE.local.md` 后做**建议性**校验：重复行、单"},{"id":"p5s10","text":"文件超出 65,536 B、超长行（默认 200 字符）、主目录/用户名/盘符绝对路径泄漏、同进程内异常缩水（< 写前 30%）。只把提示追加到该次工具结果，**绝不回滚、不新增存储、不注入提示词**"},{"id":"p5s11","text":" |
| disciplineInject | `agent/turn-stopping`（惰性判定）+ `agent.steer()` | 每 N 小时 / N 轮，把 `AGENTS.md` 的 "},{"id":"p5s12","text":"`## 项目纪律` 节重述一次（默认 3 小时、内容未变且未压缩则跳过、压缩后必补）。走**历史消息**而不是 systemPrompt —— 动态内容进系统段会废掉整段前缀缓存。缺节/超限只 war"},{"id":"p5s13","text":"` 节重述一次（默认 3 小时、内容未变且未压缩则跳过、压缩后必补）。走**历史消息**而不是 systemPrompt —— 动态内容进系统段会废掉整段前缀缓存。缺节/超限只 warn，不猜内容 |"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## 设计依据（DSH 核心源码核实）"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- 核心已内置写操作排他：`isConcurrencySafe` 分类（read/read_image 并行，edit/write/pwsh 等 exclusive 屏障），**插件不需要做 per-"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"tool 串行规则**；
- 插件唯一动态并行杠杆是池上限 `maxParallelToolCalls`（settings 活 getter，运行时 `update` 即生效）；
